extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism claims from local XML/PDF text and figure captions; no direct membrane-disruption assay in this paper is promoted beyond its evidence strength.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CaD23 shows rapid bactericidal activity against S. aureus SH1000 in time-kill assays; the local source supports this as phenotypic killing evidence, not direct membrane mechanism proof.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Time-kill kinetics establish speed of killing but do not by themselves identify the molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The discussion attributes CaD23 rapid action to likely membrane perturbation, citing prior experimental/molecular dynamics work; this paper-local record should keep the claim as inferred/discussion-level mechanism context.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct membrane permeabilization, microscopy, lipid-binding, or omics mechanism assay was recovered from local materials for this article.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Multipassage assays found no measurable AMR emergence against CaD23 over ten passages, while amikacin MIC increased; this is resistance-phenotype evidence rather than a direct target mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Resistance phenotype is compatible with rapid/membrane-active behavior but does not prove membrane disruption in this paper alone.
